Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.

Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Roorkee Project Associate- Urban Public Finance Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) for project-based contractual openings in Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: IIT Roorkee has advertised for the post of Project Associate- Urban Public Finance under advertisement number BMG-3102-HSD/26-27.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Associate- Urban Public Finance position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Economics, Statistics, or a closely related field along with relevant desirable research skills.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a competitive monthly salary ranging from Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 60,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Nil, making it free to apply for eligible applicants.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via Email. Candidates must send their applications to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q8. What is the last date to submit the application email?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the complete application via email is 10-10-2026. Make sure to send your application before this deadline.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate- Urban Public Finance post comprises an Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF and application details?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF, important dates, and application guidelines in the Important Links section of this article.
